parts.title: The Old Map
parts.text: Ruth, Tomas, and Amara found an old map in a bottle on the beach. It showed an island with a red X. The three friends climbed into a **rowboat** and rowed across the bay. Ruth held a **compass** so they would not get lost. Soon they reached a quiet **lagoon**, where the water began to **shimmer** in the sun.

parts.title: Following the Clues
parts.text: Amara looked through a **spyglass** at the tall **cliff** ahead. Tomas felt **puzzled** by the first **clue**, which read, “Walk where the wind meets the stone.” After a while, Ruth figured it out, and they climbed the path.

parts.title: The Big Dig
parts.text: At the top, they found a flat spot of sand with an X on it. Tomas, who was always **daring**, grabbed the **shovel** they had packed and started to dig. A wooden **chest** was **buried** under the sand! Inside lay a pile of shiny shells and a note that said, “The best treasure is the friends you bring.”

parts.title: Back Home
parts.text: The friends laughed and carried the shells back to the boat. They had not found gold, but they had shared a great adventure. They agreed to draw a new map of their own next time.
